name: 3 Comma Capital
prepared_for: Duarte Caldas and the 3 Comma Capital team
facts: Global Crypto, Atlantic Growth and more
position: 3 Comma Capital is an independent, CMVM-regulated Lisbon asset manager bridging traditional finance and digital-asset innovation. Its venture portfolio leans heavily into Web3, from DeFi security and tokenised real-world assets to on-chain loyalty, alongside AI holdings such as Anthropic and causaLens.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager who built crypto products at Pi Network. Your portfolio sits where I've spent my career, crypto plus identity plus AI, with companies like Nefture, Loyi, Credi and 3 Comma Digital right on top of it.
summary: 3 Comma Capital bets on the convergence of traditional finance, digital assets and AI, and the products in that space only work if users trust them: verified identities, fraud controls and onboarding that doesn't leak. At Pi Network I owned exactly that: an AI-powered KYC flow scaled from about 1M to 14M+ users with bot detection and silent bans, and I also worked on the inception of Pi's ad network. Add LLM features shipped with evals and guardrails, and customer operations at a New York ad platform, and your Web3 and AI companies match my background closely.

reasons.title: Crypto products at real scale
reasons.body: Pi Network's KYC was one of the largest identity programmes in crypto: 14M+ users, liveness, human review and bot detection. Few PMs have run Web3 onboarding at that size.

reasons.title: Security and fraud, product-side
reasons.body: I oversaw white- and black-box pentests and built silent-ban logic for bots. That's Nefture's problem space and every DeFi product's trust problem.

reasons.title: Loyalty, ads and communities
reasons.body: Loyi, Common Ground and Zoop live on engagement. I've worked on Pi's ad network and shipped community features at Campus Coach.

vc_notes.thesis: Digital assets, Web3 and AI: crypto and identity are my core domains.
vc_notes.stage: Seed to growth equity, with tickets from about $100K to $5M.
vc_notes.platform: Financing, mentorship, networking and tech support; no dedicated talent role found.
